method.timed: process creation through successful test completion, including imports/collection/fixtures/assertions/teardown
method.test_call_timing: Sum of per-case call wall times: pytest runtest_call hook vs Rust function/future body. Excludes imports, collection, Rust runtime creation and thread startup, pytest fixture setup/teardown, and timing-file writes. Includes assertions, async scheduling, and test doubles inside calls; framework dispatch is not identical.
method.build_note: Observed incremental prebuild, not clean-build cost; excluded from all samples
method.scope: Full-suite times include explicitly adapted cases and are not a paired SDK comparison. Strict set includes only manifest-approved scenarios. Neither result is cloud latency or a universal SDK speed ratio.
